data.name: LeftTop
data.comment: A tool window's place: the upper half of the left side, in its Move to menu and where it is dropped.

data.name: LeftBottom
data.comment: A tool window's place: the lower half of the left side.

data.name: RightTop
data.comment: A tool window's place: the upper half of the right side.

data.name: RightBottom
data.comment: A tool window's place: the lower half of the right side.

data.name: BottomLeft
data.comment: A tool window's place: the left half of the bottom.

data.name: BottomRight
data.comment: A tool window's place: the right half of the bottom.

data.name: ExpandAll
data.comment: The tip of a tool window's header button opening every row of its tree.

data.name: CollapseAll
data.comment: The tip of a tool window's header button closing every row of its tree.

data.name: Options
data.comment: The tip of a tool window's header button opening its menu.

data.name: Hide
data.comment: A tool window's header button and menu item putting it away.

data.name: AutoHide
data.comment: A tool window's header button, under titled tabs, sending its place's windows to the window's edge.

data.name: Close
data.comment: A tool window's header button and menu item taking it off its stripe.

data.name: Dock
data.comment: A tool window's header button and menu item docking it where it was shown over the editors.

data.name: HiddenToolWindows
data.comment: The tip of the button listing a place's tabs that have no room.

data.name: MoreToolWindows
data.comment: The tip of a stripe's button listing the windows it has no room for.

data.name: MoveTo
data.comment: A tool window's menu of the places it can stand in.

data.name: ViewMode
data.comment: A tool window's menu of how it is shown.

data.name: Docked
data.comment: A tool window's view mode: docked in its place.

data.name: Floating
data.comment: A tool window's view mode: in a window kept over the IDE's.

data.name: Windowed
data.comment: A tool window's view mode: in a window of its own the system manages.

data.name: InEditor
data.comment: A tool window's view mode: a tab among the editors.

data.name: Maximize
data.comment: A tool window's menu item giving it the window's room.

data.name: RestoreSize
data.comment: A maximised tool window's menu item giving it back its own room.

data.name: LeftEdge
data.comment: What a screen reader hears entering the left edge's tabs of hidden tool windows.

data.name: RightEdge
data.comment: What a screen reader hears entering the right edge's tabs of hidden tool windows.

data.name: BottomEdge
data.comment: What a screen reader hears entering the bottom edge's tabs of hidden tool windows.

data.name: DropInEditors
data.comment: Where a tool window dragged over the editors goes; {window} is its name.

data.name: DropIn
data.comment: Where a dragged tool window goes; {window} is its name and {place} the place, as Left Top.
